name: Beasts of Chi No Mizumi
source:
The story is set in a world where humans have canine features. The game is heavily inspired by certain elements of traditional Japanese culture, though it is not meant to be entirely accurate.

[From [url=https://sillyfart.itch.io/chi-no-mizumi]Itch.io[/url]]
